# Third-party USB audio dependencies

## libusb

- Source: https://github.com/libusb/libusb
- Revision: `a45bb163a603ac5ae3499806b151509848b0065c`
- License: LGPL-2.1-or-later
- License text: `libusb/COPYING`

## libuac

- Source: https://github.com/nExtCamera/libuac
- Revision: `17a6ba0a09309a6890ec338826de43a256f89813`
- License: Apache-2.0
- License text: `libuac/LICENSE`

`libuac` provides a USB Audio Class user-space driver and currently supports
UAC1 input streams. `libusb` provides the Android-compatible USB transport
layer used by the driver.

## FDK-AAC

- Source: https://github.com/mstorsjo/fdk-aac
- Revision: `7c83d08002332b2730c845eec3497e6bf585dd28`
- License: Fraunhofer FDK AAC Codec Library for Android license
- License text: `fdk-aac/NOTICE`

FDK-AAC provides AAC-LC encoding and decoding for Wi-Fi audio transport.
